method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Equities: Defensive rotation with higher yields – Danske Bank
Equities.summary: Danske Research Team reports a marked drop in global equities, with the S&P 500 and Stoxx 600 down 0.7% on Tuesday. After a period of value-versus-growth rotation, flows shifted toward defensive sectors such as consumer staples and health care, funded by c
Equities.reason: Highlights market-wide defensive rotation driven by higher yields — supports a negative equity-risk impulse (growth/tech under pressure, rotation to defensives). Relevance moderate as it summarizes broad flow dynamics.

Equities.title: Korean Stocks Bear Brunt of Chip Slide Spurred by Rise in Yields
Equities.reason: Direct evidence that rising yields are materially hurting semiconductor stocks and regional equity markets — significant negative for global tech/AI leadership narrative and risk sentiment, high regional market impact.

Equities.title: SK Hynix to buy back, cancel $29 billion worth of treasury shares
Equities.reason: Large, market-supportive buyback / share-cancellation is a material positive for SK Hynix and the semiconductor sector amid recent weakness — boosts corporate liquidity/return-of-capital narrative.

Equities.title: Home Depot reaffirms guidance amid 'frozen housing market conditions'
Equities.summary: Home Depot reported second fiscal quarter results that beat Wall Street expectations on the top and bottom lines.
Equities.reason: Solid earnings and reaffirmed guidance from a large-cap consumer cyclical name signal company-level resilience — modestly positive for market breadth and defensive resilience during a yield-driven pullback.

Equities.title: Bond selloff slows but stocks wobble
Equities.reason: Confirms ongoing bond-driven market strain: bond volatility and higher yields continue to weigh on equities, reinforcing negative macro/liquidity backdrop for risk assets.

Equities.title: China eases limits on Nvidia H200 chips as AI race escalates
Equities.summary: Beijing permits small shipments to help leading tech groups in drive to catch up with US rivals
Equities.reason: Policy easing on AI-capable chips from China reduces a key supply / trade risk for global AI supply chains — supportive for semiconductors and AI leadership stocks, partially offsetting yield-pressure narrative.

Equities.title: Nvidia's AI moat is shifting from chips to capital
Equities.summary: Nvidia still has dominant market share in AI chips, but with competition picking up steam, the company is taking greater advantage of another key asset.
Equities.reason: Reinforces the dominant market narrative that AI leadership remains concentrated (NVIDIA) and that capital intensity is the next moat — positive for large-cap AI names and for sector concentration themes.

Equities.title: Contrarian vs. the crowd: One trader made a massive bet against chip stocks
Equities.summary: The biggest single options trade in the entire market Monday was a $129 million bet against the VanEck Semiconductor ETF.
Equities.reason: Large directional positioning against semiconductor ETF signals heightened bearish sentiment/hedging in chips — a useful positioning datapoint but lower relevance than macro yield story.

Equities.title: Japan’s Earnings Surprise Analysts to Fuel Bets for Broad Rally
Equities.reason: Stronger-than-expected corporate earnings in Japan provide a regional earnings-led bullish counterpoint and could underpin broader risk appetite if earnings momentum continues.

Rates.title: 30-year Treasury yield tops 5.33%, new 19-year high, on inflation and spending concerns
Rates.summary: Long-dated fixed income hit their highest level in almost two decades amid a worsening U.S. fiscal situation and persistently higher inflation.
Rates.reason: Large move higher in long-end U.S. yields is strongly negative for bond prices and signals a sustained global selloff driven by inflation and fiscal concerns. High relevance as it sets the dominant rates narrative.

Rates.title: Treasury yields pull back from multi-decade highs ahead of FOMC minutes
Rates.summary: The yield on the 10-year U.S. Treasury note — the key benchmark for U.S. government borrowing — fell 2 basis points to 4.686%.
Rates.reason: Small near-term pullback in yields (2bps) is modestly positive for bonds but does not alter the broader higher-for-longer regime; relevant as an immediate market reaction ahead of FOMC minutes.

Rates.title: Korea Yield Curve Steepest Since 2021 as Long-Bond Slump Deepens
Rates.reason: Regional long-end selloff and curve steepening are negative for bond prices and reinforce the global selloff narrative; medium relevance as a significant regional datapoint.

Rates.title: China Bonds Buck Global Selloff on Policy Divide With Peers
Rates.reason: China bond outperformance represents a material regional divergence: supportive for local bonds (yields relatively lower) and reduces some uniformity of the global selloff narrative; moderate relevance.

Rates.title: Bond Traders Are Hedging Risk Fed Pivots to Rate Cuts in 2027
Rates.reason: Markets hedging for a future Fed pivot implies some probability of eventual easing priced in, which is modestly positive for bond prices as a counterbalance to the near-term rout; moderate but not dominant relevance.

Rates.title: Wall Street Sees No End in Sight to the Global Bond Selloff
Rates.reason: Consensus market view that the bond selloff is ongoing reinforces a negative rates regime (higher-for-longer yields); high relevance as it reflects broader market positioning and expectations.

Rates.title: Morning Bid: Dancing robots, dumping bonds
Rates.reason: Morning note framing the theme of bond dumping contributes to the prevailing negative narrative around global bonds; relevant as a market commentary reinforcing flows.

FX.title: US Dollar: Range-bound trading as FOMC minutes loom – ING
FX.summary: ING’s Chris Turner notes that the Dollar remains supported by higher energy prices and long-end US yields, but FX volatility is still low, favouring carry trades.
FX.reason: ING highlights USD support from higher energy and long-end US yields — a USD-strength signal. It's a clear USD-centric view but describes range-bound dynamics (not extreme), so medium relevance and moderate negative direction for USD-weakness axis (negative = USD strength).

FX.title: United States Dollar Index slumps in countdown to FOMC minutes
FX.summary: The US Dollar (USD) trades lower against its major currency peers on Wednesday ahead of the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) minutes of the July policy meeting, which will be published at 18:00 GMT.
FX.reason: Direct DXY/USD weakness ahead of FOMC minutes — immediate USD-flow story with clear FX transmission. Elevated relevance given DXY moves and event timing (minutes release).

FX.title: Swiss Franc picks up within range, USDollar softens awaiting Fed minutes
FX.summary: The Swiss Franc (CHF) appreciates moderately on Wednesday, as the US Dollar (USD) pulls back against major peers, with investors bracing for the release of the minutes of July’s Federal Reserve (Fed) monetary policy meeting, due later on the day.
FX.reason: CHF gains reported as USD softens into Fed minutes — supports a USD-weakness theme. Regional FX move (safe-haven CHF) with moderate relevance to USD flow.

FX.title: Asia FX: Lower US yields offset Oil risk – MUFG
FX.summary: MUFG’s Lloyd Chan notes that the Korean Won (KRW) and Taiwan Dollar (TWD) are leading Asia FX gains as softer US yields and a resilient technology cycle support sentiment.
FX.reason: Softer US yields are helping Asian FX (KRW, TWD) appreciate — direct USD-yield transmission. Relevant for regional USD/Asia pairs and broader dollar narrative.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: BoJ’s hawkish pivot reshapes outlook against US Dollar - Standard Chartered
FX.summary: Standard Chartered strategists have revised its Bank of Japan (BoJ) rate outlook, bringing forward its expected 25bps hike from October to September and raising its terminal rate forecast to 1.75% from 1.50% previously.
FX.reason: BoJ hawkish pivot materially raises JPY rate differentials vs USD — a significant FX fundamental driver implying JPY appreciation and broader USD weakness vs major crosses. High relevance as a central-bank regime shift.

FX.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Bears look at 1.3850 support after rejection at 1.3900
FX.summary: The US Dollar (USD) resumes its broader bearish trend with the Canadian Dollar (CAD) drawing support from higher Oil prices and a deal with the US to pause 50% tariffs on Canadian exports.
FX.reason: Pair-level technical/forecast tied to commodity (oil) and tariff news — implies CAD strength (USD weakness). Price-forecast piece so relevance capped (technical focus).

FX.title: Canadian Dollar: Tariff delay offers only muted relief – Commerzbank
FX.summary: Michael Pfister at Commerzbank reports that new 50% US tariffs on selected Canadian goods have been delayed by three days as an agreement is reportedly close, prompting only a modest Canadian Dollar (CAD) rebound amid uncertainty over the deal’s durability.
FX.reason: Tariff-delay news provides modest CAD support vs USD but uncertainty mutes the move — directly FX-relevant (trade/policy shock), medium relevance.

FX.title: Indian Rupee trades lower amid higher oil prices, early FCNR (B) closure
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) remains vulnerable against the US Dollar (USD), close to its two-week low at around 95.75.
FX.reason: INR weakness cited and linked to higher oil costs — a typical commodity-to-EMFX transmission that implies USD strength vs INR. Direct FX impact for USD/INR pair.

FX.title: British Pound edges up within range following hotter UK inflation data
FX.summary: The British Pound (GBP) ticked up against the US Dollar (USD) on Monday, following the release of UK inflation data.
FX.reason: Hotter UK inflation supports GBP vs USD — direct central-bank/inflation-to-FX link with clear transmission into GBPUSD moves.

FX.title: Indonesian Rupiah holds firm as BI keeps rate steady at 5.75%
FX.summary: USD/IDR depreciates after registering modest gains in the previous day, trading around 17,870 during the European hours on Wednesday. The pair holds losses as the Indonesian Rupiah (IDR) remains stronger following the release of the interest rate decision by t
FX.reason: BI decision and IDR firmness imply local-rate support for the currency vs USD — direct FX-central-bank transmission with moderate relevance.

FX.title: South Korean Won Advances Past Key Level of 1,400 Per Dollar
FX.reason: Headline indicates KRW strength past a psychological FX level vs USD — direct, market-relevant FX movement for USD/KRW.

FX.title: NZD/USD Price Forecast: Weakens below 0.5900, but staying supported above 100-day SMA
FX.summary: The NZD/USD pair trades with mild losses around 0.5875 during the early European session on Wednesday. Escalating tensions in the Middle East boost a safe-haven currency such as the US Dollar (USD) and act as a headwind for the pair.
FX.reason: Technical price-forecast noting NZD weakness tied to safe-haven USD flows from Middle East tensions. As a forecast/technical piece, relevance is capped.

FX.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Rising 20-day EMA supports near-term bullish bias
FX.summary: The Australian Dollar (AUD) underperforms its major currency peers on Wednesday, trading 0.17% lower at around 0.7070 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session.
FX.reason: Pair-level technical/short-term note showing AUD underperformance and USD strength; technical focus limits relevance.

FX.title: ECB's Rehn: Keeping inflation expectations anchored is essential
FX.summary: European Central Bank (ECB) official and Finnish Central Bank Governor Olli Rehn said in a written copy of a speech, released during the European trading session on Wednesday, that it is essential to keep inflation expectations anchored.
FX.reason: ECB official emphasizes anchoring inflation expectations — signals ECB vigilance/hawkish bias that supports EUR vs USD. Central-bank rhetoric is directly FX-relevant and elevates EUR upside probability.

Commodities.title: Oil: Inventory draws and risk premiums support prices – ING
Commodities.summary: ING strategists Ewa Manthey and Warren Patterson note that Oil prices have risen for a fourth straight session, supported by US-Iran tensions and concerns over shipping through the Strait of Hormuz.
Commodities.reason: ING highlights inventory draws plus a geopolitical risk premium (US-Iran / Strait of Hormuz), a clear bullish supply-side driver for crude. High relevance because the story combines physical draws with shipping/geopolitical risk that typically moves oil prices.

Commodities.title: Oil Advances for Fourth Day With US and Iran Locked in Stalemate
Commodities.reason: Headline signals sustained oil upside driven by a US–Iran standoff; Bloomberg coverage implies a broad market impact. Elevated relevance since continued multi-day gains amid geopolitical stalemate are a strong bullish theme for crude.

Commodities.title: United States on track for record natural gas production in 2026
Commodities.summary: We forecast U.S. marketed natural gas production will average 122.5 billion cubic feet per day (Bcf/d) in 2026, surpassing the previous record of 118.5 Bcf/d set in 2025, in our August 2026 Short-Term Energy Outlook (STEO).
Commodities.reason: EIA projects record U.S. gas output, a clear bearish fundamental for natural gas prices via higher supply. Relevance is material given the national-scale production update from the EIA.

Commodities.title: Waterborne shipments from the U.S. Gulf Coast increased in April and May
Commodities.summary: Waterborne shipments of crude oil and petroleum products from the U.S. Gulf Coast (PADD 3) to the West Coast (PADD 5) more than quadrupled year-on-year in April and May following a waiver that permitted a broader group of ships to travel between U.S. ports. Sh
Commodities.reason: Large increase in inter‑U.S. waterborne shipments eases regional supply/logistics frictions for refined products/crude to the West Coast — a modest bearish/normalizing influence on regional crude/product spreads. Relevance is limited to regional flow dynamics.

Commodities.title: Gold: Pullback risk with higher yields and Oil – OCBC
Commodities.summary: OCBC’s Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong note that Gold’s rebound has lost momentum as renewed Oil gains and higher long-end US yields revive inflation concerns. Daily charts show fading bullish momentum and a lower Relative Strength Index (RSI) from near ove
Commodities.reason: OCBC flags fading gold momentum driven by higher long-end U.S. yields (negative for non-yielding gold) even as oil gains add an inflation/Risk premium nuance. Relevance moderate — technical + macro yield pressure is a meaningful near-term gold headwind.

Commodities.title: Gold Holds Losses as Bond Selloff, Hormuz Limbo Weigh on Outlook
Commodities.reason: Headline links a bond selloff (higher yields) to continued gold weakness despite Middle East tensions — a strong negative for gold via the rate channel. High relevance due to combination of macro (yields) and geopolitical considerations.

Commodities.title: Gold climbs back above $4,350 as USD remains depressed ahead of FOMC Minutes
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) climbs back above $4,350 during the first half of the European session, reversing a part of the previous day's heavy losses.
Commodities.reason: Short‑term USD softness ahead of Fed minutes gives gold a modest bounce. Counter‑signal to the dominant yield headwind; relevance is limited and tactical.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecasts: XAG/USD tests levels sub-$63.00 as bearish pressure mounts
Commodities.summary: Silver (XAG/USD) trades lower for the second consecutive day on Wednesday, exploring prices below the $63.00 level at the time of writing, after a reversal from the $66.50 area on Tuesday.
Commodities.reason: FXStreet notes renewed bearish pressure on silver with a break below key levels; silver is sensitive to the same yields/metal-demand dynamics weighing on gold, so this is a relevant short‑term bearish signal.

Crypto.title: U.S. SEC proposes first major crypto rule in surprise announcement
Crypto.reason: Major regulatory initiative from the SEC represents material legal/regulatory clarity for the crypto sector; under the 1XW framework regulation/adoption is a net positive for the asset class. High relevance because an SEC rule can shift institutional demand and custody flows.

Crypto.title: U.S. accounting-standards group proposes way to see stablecoins as 'cash equivalent'
Crypto.reason: Accounting recognition of stablecoins as cash-equivalents materially lowers frictions for corporate and institutional use of stablecoins — a structural adoption positive for crypto rails and settlement. Very high relevance given broad accounting/finance implications.

Crypto.title: Citi plans to launch bitcoin custody for institutional clients later this year
Crypto.reason: Large global bank adding institutional custody is a clear adoption/institutionalization signal that should support flows into BTC and institutional activity; relevance is material but below top-tier regulatory moves.

Crypto.title: Cash App's crypto support expands beyond bitcoin and USDC via MoonPay
Crypto.reason: Retail distribution expansion via a major consumer app increases accessibility and potential retail flows — positive for adoption but lower relevance than institutional/regulatory developments.

Crypto.title: HashKey taps Hong Kong's first regulated stablecoin to settle insurance and trade deals
Crypto.reason: Use of a regulated stablecoin for trade/insurance settlement is a positive signal for on‑chain settlement use cases and institutionalization in APAC — supportive for stablecoin demand and rails.

Crypto.title: Wyoming joins $15 billion LayerZero exodus with state stablecoin move
Crypto.reason: State-level stablecoin initiative signals subnational adoption and creative use of stablecoins; positive for the broader stablecoin narrative but more niche in scope than federal/regulatory moves.

Crypto.title: Visa looking for new stablecoin settlement partner after BVNK sale to Mastercard
Crypto.reason: Payments giant sourcing stablecoin settlement partner is a modestly positive signal for continued integration of stablecoins into payments rails; relevance limited to payments/settlement flows.

Crypto.title: Will Bitcoin Drop Below $60K as BTC ETFs See Biggest Outflow in 6 Weeks?
Crypto.reason: Notable ETF outflows are a concrete near-term negative for BTC liquidity and price; ETF flow dynamics remain an important demand driver for spot BTC, so this is a meaningful short-term headwind.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin pauses at $64,000 as rising yields, oil drag equities lower
Crypto.reason: Macro risk-off — rising yields and weaker equities — is dragging on bitcoin risk appetite. Under 1XW rules macro liquidity/yields moving against risk assets is negative for crypto.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin has gone quiet as traders chase ‘5x or 10x’ payoffs elsewhere
Crypto.reason: Trader rotation into higher-leverage alt/derivative plays reduces spot BTC activity and demand; this is a moderate short-term negative for BTC flows and volatility profile.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin miners’ AI pivot pays off, but mining could revive with one twist
Crypto.reason: Miners diversifying into AI workloads and monetizing infrastructure is a positive commercial-development story for the mining cohort and capital economics; modest positive for the ecosystem.

Crypto.title: Spot Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs: The difference between owning the coin and the fund
Crypto.reason: Educational piece on ETF vs. direct ownership has limited immediate market impact; small positive for informed investor access and potential flows but low relevance per 1XW technical/content rules.

Crypto.title: ‘It has to pass’: Andrew Cuomo warns U.S. is falling behind on crypto rules
Crypto.reason: Political push and public advocacy for crypto legislation/regulation increases probability of clearer federal rules — net positive for institutional participation and long-term adoption.

Crypto.title: South Korea joins more than 30 jurisdictions restricting Polymarket access
Crypto.reason: Additional jurisdictional restrictions on a crypto-native prediction-market platform are a localized regulatory headwind; limited systemic relevance but negative for the prediction-market niche.

Crypto.title: Ethereum’s next upgrade breaks the '21,000 gas' rule wallets rely on
Crypto.reason: Protocol change that alters gas assumptions may cause short-term wallet/integration friction; technical upgrade risk is relevant to ETH usability but low-to-moderate impact on the overall asset-class narrative.
